dedupe_keys.name: balm truck toll statistics mautdaten tabellenwerk and mautdaten bund germany

description: Germany's Federal Office for Logistics and Mobility (BALM), which enforces the heavy goods vehicle toll whose collection system is run by Toll Collect, publishes statistics built from toll data. The Mautdaten Tabellenwerk, continued from the Mautstatistik published since 2008, gives monthly and annual cross-tables of the kilometres driven and trips made by tolled trucks by various criteria, each compared with the previous period, starting in January 2008; Mautdaten Bund gives toll revenue, tolled vehicle-kilometres and section passages for individual sections of the federal trunk roads; Mautverkehr KOMPAKT summarises trends in charts; and the Lkw-Verkehrsportal visualises anonymised historical section data. BALM also publishes the toll table of all tolled section lengths, enforcement statistics and a survey of road haulage companies. Coverage is national: the tolled network grew from about 12,800 km of motorways in 2005 to 52,000 km including all federal roads from July 2018, and tolled truck mileage was 40.5 billion km in 2025. The data are free under the Data Licence Germany Attribution 2.0, as downloadable tables with methodological notes in German and English. Caveats: comparisons over time are affected by changes in the tolled network and in the weight classes liable to toll (7.5 tonnes from 2015, more than 3.5 tonnes from July 2024). The section-level volumes support freight network flow, capacity planning and forecasting of the German road network, and complement the Freight Analysis Framework approach used in the US.
